title: GM 2.4 Ecotec (LEA): excessive oil consumption
body: Rings stick from coking and the engine burns oil, sometimes a quart per 1000 miles or worse. Running low on oil then wears the timing chain (rattle, P0008/P0016). 2010-2013 are the worst. GM had a special coverage program with updated pistons/rings and a PCV update; check the VIN. Do an oil consumption test before quoting rings.
author: OpenBay seed (unsourced, needs citations)
